text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- Swiss citizens on Sunday rejected labour law revisions which would have opened the way for more overtime and lifted a ban on women working night shifts in factories.
- Union Bank of Switzerland is selling 40 percent of its stake in Swiss utility concern Motor Columbus.
- Men's clothing group PKZ will take over Feldplausch Group and continue to employ 90 percent of the 300 people currently working for the group. PKZ has 27 stores in major Swiss cities.
- A 53.6 percent majority of Swiss voters rejected a referendum which, if passed, would have barred foreigners entering the country illegally from applying for political asylum.
- Voters in Geneva turned down the "La Suisse" referendum which called for the state to take measures to support the press and prevent the creation of media monopolies.
